
== Draft Dictionary And Related Files ==

=== [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/ draft-dictionary] ===

This directory contains draft material for the forthcoming

Lojban-English/English-Lojban dictionary (expected out in late 2000

or 2001).

A draft version of

[http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/ENGDICT.GIS The English-Lojban version of the gismu]

(engdict.gis - 2.1 Meg) is available. This can be downloaded as a

[http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/ENGDICT.ZIP zipped file]

(engdict.zip - 556K). Nora LeChevalier's working

[http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/NORALUJV.txt ujvo-list with place structures]

is also available (noralujv.txt - 790K)

=== [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Temporary/ raft-dictionary/Temporary] ===

This directory contains temporary and unofficial dictionary

information in TeX and PostScript formats. Here is the

[http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Temporary/dict. .README]

(dict.README) file. For other files, please browse the directory.

=== [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Working/ raft-dictionary/Working] ===

This directory contains the latest compendium of working files

being used in creating the Lojban dictionary. Among the archives

are:

* [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Working/gism1999.ZIP gismu], [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Working/luj1999.ZIP ujvo], and [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Working/mwds1999.ZIP misc] wordlists with frequencies derived from that text and others, current to 5 December 1999 (xxxx1999.zip). Volunteers are sought to aid in preparing these lists for use as dictionary files. Contact Bob LeChevalier, [mailto:lojban@lojban.org] to volunteer.
* a [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Working/dictbook.ZIP file skeleton] (dictbook.zip) of the original draft outline of the dictionary, much of which is obsolete or supplanted by publication in the Reference Grammar,

* a mapping of words from Lojban to TLI Loglan (oldlog.txt)
* various semi-editted KWIC files based on the [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Working/gismkwic.ZIP gismu] (gismkwic.zip) and [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/Working/cmavkwic.ZIP cmavo] (cmavkwic.zip) lists to be used to generate additional dictionary entries.
